decision: Native-CRS DEM visualization only; precise local CTX co-registration NOT verified. Full-opacity default; no fitted shifts, routing, hazard or safety certification.

selected.vertical_reference: MOLA areoid, metres positive up (PLACES SIS section 3.9.3). Not sphere radial height. No datum offset or fitted height bias applied.
selected.provenance: Mission-localization DEM described by PLACES SIS section 4.5: USGS HiRISE mosaic with CTX backfill, registered through corresponding orthophotos. Native 1 m grid does not establish uniform 1 m resolving power.
selected.time_context: PDS release v42.0 time bounds describe mission archive coverage, not constituent stereo acquisition dates. Per-pixel source/acquisition map unavailable.
selected.unit_label_caveat: PDS4 Element_Array unit is the generic DN. The physical metre/areoid interpretation comes from the PLACES SIS section 3.9.3 and section 4.5 DEM definition, not the DN tag. The source has no additional scale or offset; no scaling inferred from image appearance.

coverage.support: Complete rectangle verified from all pixels for this pinned window; no validity claimed beyond it. 25 m exterior ring omitted for full 3 x 3 support.
coverage.anchor: Historical Sol 2300 rover position used only to choose an AOI, never as photographed-target coordinates. Portions of the historical traverse intersect this window. No science-target locations changed.

resolution.effective_resolution: Source-dependent HiRISE/CTX mosaic; no per-pixel resolving-power map. 25 m averaging / 75 m gradient support are processing scales, not a guaranteed ground resolving power.
resolution.uncertainty: Absolute vertical/horizontal error and slope error are not quantitatively certified. Mixed source quality, seams, interpolation and stereo artifacts remain. Coarsening does not prove CTX backfill resolving power or remove all artifacts.

alignment.documentary_reference: PLACES SIS section 4.5 registers DEM and associated mission orthophotos; G1 audited coordinate convention for CTX. This is not evidence of precise local CTX feature registration.

direct_local_check.method: 64x64 local PDS image samples compared with committed NASA CTX display pixels at unmodified published coordinates. No fitted shifts. This tests display convention, not survey accuracy.

unapplied_translation_diagnostic.interpretation: Suggests positional mismatch, not an accepted transform, survey offset or correction. No shift applied.

alignment.interpretation: Low/negative local DN agreement does not validate alignment. A smoothed translation diagnostic on the central 32 x 32 patch peaks at row+12,column+3 of a 16.15 m sample grid (score about0.84), suggesting substantial mismatch. This is NOT an accepted transformation, survey offset estimate or applied correction. Other corridor windows also failed direct-match checks. No precise CTX/DEM co-registration claim.
alignment.rendering_policy: Retain original published coordinates; full opacity by default, explicit mismatch warning in coverage and limitations. User-controlled opacity is exploratory only. Independent native-CRS elevation/slope visualization remains useful; no coincident fine-feature interpretation.

rejected_candidates.reason: Individual DTM not in mission-controlled mosaic frame; 2304 paired PDS checks: median source-minus-reference +6.21 m, RMSE7.04 m. A translation diagnostic indicates unresolved registration differences. No correction applied; not integrated. Reference mosaic is not independent ground truth.
Authoritative larger mixed HiRISE/CTX/HRSC/MOLA mosaic, ~3.6 GB. Not downloaded; source QA zones and full valid-pixel coverage unaudited. Selected manageable PDS mission mosaic subset instead.

derivatives.numeric_arrays: Rebuilt into ignored output/g3-2/analysis-values.npz; PNGs encode display colors, not numeric DEMs.
derivatives.mask_policy: Nonfinite/special float posts invalid; every block and all 9 gradient neighbors must be valid. Unsupported outer analysis ring omitted; transparent outside actual support. No filling/interpolation across gaps.

authoritative_references.context: JPL D-78442 release1.3 RevA, 2016-07-01; section 3.9 metre metric, section 3.9.3 areoid, section 4.5 orthophoto/DEM provenance. Current PDS4 label controls v42 dimensions/offsets.
HiRISE stereo provenance, MOLA ties, posts versus effective resolution and known artifacts.

unsupported: Whole Gale or whole-traverse terrain coverage
Per-pixel effective resolution or quantitative elevation/slope error
Terrain safety, hazards, trafficability, route optimization or resource calculations
New target coordinates or target geological boundaries

verification.scientific_alignment_gate: precise local CTX co-registration not verified; no corrective transformation applied
